section_text_with_unit_anchors:
[v7u_N004020|4020] OneFrance, a fully digital challenger bank operating in France plans to expand into the rest of Europe. The bank hires Marie as a consultant to review the effectiveness and efficiency of its onboarding technology. OneFrance prides itself on using advanced technology throughout its AFC program, including the onboarding process.
ZH: 案例：法国数字银行OneFrance计划扩张，聘请顾问审查其金融犯罪防控准入技术

[v7u_N004021|4021] Marie is an expert in digital banking, regulatory technology, and compliance. She assesses the bank’s electronic KYC processes and notices various deficiencies.
ZH: Marie评估银行的电子了解你的客户流程并发现缺陷

[v7u_N004022|4022] As part of OneFrance’s onboarding process, customers must take a selfie and submit it on the app to be verified against documents they have.
ZH: 客户需在应用程序上提交自拍照以验证身份

[v7u_N004023|4023] During the process, the geolocation of the customers is recorded to ensure they are within the EU when opening an account.
ZH: 开户时记录客户地理位置以确保其在欧盟境内

[v7u_N004024|4024] The bank also screens all the new customers’ names against the required sanctions lists during onboarding.
ZH: 银行在开户时对所有新客户姓名进行制裁名单筛查

[v7u_N004025|4025] Marie notes that currently the system only verifies 80% of customers through facial recognition technology.
ZH: 当前系统仅通过面部识别技术验证80%的客户

[v7u_N004026|4026] This is due to the inadequacy of the system the bank purchased from a vendor.
ZH: 低验证率源于银行从供应商处购买的系统不完善

[v7u_N004027|4027] The system does not incorporate strong liveness checks and is not properly integrated with the document processing system that extracts ID pictures from identity books and passports.
ZH: 系统缺乏活体检测且未与证件处理系统集成

[v7u_N004028|4028] The system cannot reliably match selfies customers take during the onboarding process to ID pictures.
ZH: 系统无法可靠地将客户自拍照与证件照片匹配

[v7u_N004029|4029] This leads to a team of analysts manually checking unverified customers, increasing onboarding time.
ZH: 未验证客户需分析师手动检查，增加开户时间

[v7u_N004030|4030] Marie also identifies that during the screening process, one specific common French name keeps matching against the European sanctions list, generating false positives that analysts must address.
ZH: 常见法国名字与欧盟制裁名单匹配产生误报

[v7u_N004031|4031] After further investigation, she notes that the system uses partial match logic to identify possible hits and does not allow deviations in names.
ZH: 系统使用部分匹配逻辑且不允许姓名偏差

[v7u_N004032|4032] The system keeps matching “Henri” against “Henrik,” which is indicated on the list.
ZH: 误报示例：'Henri'与名单上的'Henrik'匹配

[v7u_N004033|4033] Similarly, the system seems to be missing matches when the name is slightly different from its appearance on watch lists.
ZH: 系统在姓名与观察名单略有差异时遗漏匹配
